prompt:
STYLE (keep identical across the series): a dark, grim key-art illustration for a 2D pixel-art roguelike, rendered as a detailed pixel-art scene painting with chunky, clearly readable shapes and flat shading (no soft airbrush, no photo texture, no film grain). Limited palette: near-black charcoal and cold ash grays carry the whole image; ONE warm accent only - amber / ember orange to pale gold (#8b4d22, #d67a11, #e8b858, #faeec0) - used sparingly for fire, embers, lantern light, spilled liquor and glowing eyes. No other hues at all: no blue, no green, no purple, no red. Strong value structure: deep black silhouettes against dim gray midtones, the brightest values only in the amber accents. World: grounded, realistic Renaissance-era early-gunpowder setting (pikes, longbows, matchlock muskets, mud, supply wagons, timber-and-plaster houses, oak barrels); fantasy appears only as rare eerie touches. Mood: desperate and bleak, dry and weary, with a sly undertone of dark humor - like a gritty frontier western crossed with a dark fantasy. Cinematic widescreen composition, side or three-quarter view, clear foreground / middle / background layers, strong focal point. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no watermark, no frame or border.
SCENE: The endless battlefield wasteland outside the liquor empire "Zan". Cracked dry earth and churned mud at dusk, a low heavy overcast sky. Broken pikes and swords stuck in the ground at angles, torn banners hanging from leaning poles, dented helmets and shields of fallen soldiers half-buried, a toppled supply cart with one broken wheel. Small ember-colored will-o'-the-wisp soul flames drift up from the fallen and gather toward the center-left, where a faint human silhouette is forming out of the gathered soul fire - the only bright point near the ground. Far on the right horizon, the dark walls and towers of a walled city-empire with a few tiny amber window lights and thin smoke columns, hinting at the destination.
